description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Swipe (mouse drag) from [x,y] to [x,y] over an optional duration in ms; to move a list use phone_scroll. The mirror delivers a drag as pointer input, so a swipe that starts on an app icon picks the icon up and moves it (it can rearrange the Home Screen or make a folder): page the Home Screen from the empty strip just above the Dock (y about 0.80), never across the icon rows. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_swipe
